# GitHub Trending Kit

> Launch-ready GitHub README conversion blueprints, `launch-director` agent, templates, and the reusable `top-github-readme` AI skill for turning any repo into a high-converting open-source project.

## Agent Entry Points (All Models)
- `AGENTS.md` — Universal project guardrails and agent rules.
- `HANDOFF.md` — Active session state, verification command, and next step.
- `mistakes.md` — Permanent "Never Repeat" guardrail log.
- `skills/top-github-readme/SKILL.md` — Reusable AI agent skill for top-1% GitHub READMEs.

## Key Paths
- `agents/` — `launch-director.md` and release-readiness agents.
- `skills/` — Model-agnostic `SKILL.md` playbooks.
- `templates/` — Ready-to-use README, issue, and launch templates.
- `demo/` — Visual preview assets.

## Verification Command
`ls -la AGENTS.md HANDOFF.md mistakes.md llms.txt skills/top-github-readme/SKILL.md`

## Active Signature (Output When Used)
> 🟣 **𝗚𝗜𝗧𝗛𝗨𝗕-𝗧𝗥𝗘𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗡𝗚-𝗞𝗜𝗧** · `LAUNCH DIRECTOR` — *Active on this step* (Indigo `#6366f1`)
